Karthik Subbaraj's film 'Dorothy' to premiere at TIFF

Karthik Subbaraj's upcoming film, titled 'Dorothy', is scheduled for its world premiere in the TIFF Centrepiece section of the Toronto International Film Festival. The film, which stars Keerthy Suresh, Sananth, and Rishikanth, features music composed by Ilaiyaraaja. A teaser for 'Dorothy' has been released, hinting at a suspense-filled village thriller with Keerthy Suresh in a mysterious role. This marks Subbaraj's 10th directorial venture.
